name: Niharra (Spain)
description: Square flag, the upper two thirds blue within a yellow frame and the lower third white, charged with the crowned municipal arms of Niharra (a bird on blue above a stone wall on white).
history: The arms and the flag were approved officially on 6 May 1997 (Boletín Oficial de Castilla y León no. 109 of 10 June 1997); the flag is described as square.

features.role: yellow frame around the blue panel
